# Charles Jiang, MD, MPH

> Changchuan (Charles) Jiang is a genitourinary medical oncologist and health services researcher at UT Southwestern Medical Center (Harold C. Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center) and Parkland Health in Dallas, Texas. Assistant Professor of Internal Medicine (Hematology/Oncology) and in the Peter O'Donnell Jr. School of Public Health.

## Focus areas
- Clinical trial access and equity: leads UT Southwestern's prostate cancer clinical trial access program across a county safety-net hospital (Parkland Health) and community sites, supported by the American Cancer Society (IMPACT Special Initiative Award, PI). Director, GU Clinical Trial Optimization, Parkland Cancer Center. Conquer Cancer Foundation/ASCO Career Development Award on physician-level factors in trial enrollment. Robert A. Winn Excellence in Clinical Trials CDA.
- Supportive care and health access: Co-Chair, Health Access and Disparities Committee, Multinational Association of Supportive Care in Cancer (MASCC). Research on transportation barriers, financial hardship, palliative care value, and supportive-care drug access.
- Insurance design and cancer care delivery: zero-premium Medicare Advantage plans, plan benefit design, prior authorization, oncologist networks, Part D formulary access, Medicaid expansion.
- AI in the oncology workflow: PI of an NCCN/Pfizer quality improvement award embedding reflex biomarker testing and a molecular-actionability dashboard in the EHR at a safety-net cancer program; member of the UTSW Simmons Cancer Center AI Steering Committee; LLM-generated plain-language trial summaries; scholarship on value alignment and licensure of clinical AI.

## Advisory areas
Clinical development and trial strategy (GU oncology); market access, HEOR, and US payer policy (Medicare Advantage, Part D, prior authorization); real-world evidence design (Flatiron Health, ConcertAI, SEER-Medicare, Epic Cosmos); AI in the oncology workflow; supportive care and care delivery; teaching and speaking.
